pkgmetadata.longdescription: ntx is a BitTorrent client in one small C binary. C11 + POSIX, libc + libm only: no OpenSSL, no vendored libraries. Cryptography, TLS 1.3/1.2 and DoH are implemented in-tree. Downloads magnet links and .torrent files (v1, v2, hybrid), verifies pieces, resumes from disk and seeds after completion.
